resources.string: Portable diary backup. Food names, dates, amounts and nutrition are included; OCR diagnostics and settings are excluded. Keep the file private.
Merge preserves existing entries. Identical entries are skipped; conflicting entries are reported and never overwrite your diary.
Replace your entire diary? Entries in backup: %1$d. A private recovery backup is saved first. Export the recovery backup from this screen and import it to restore your previous diary.
I understand that all current diary entries will be replaced.
The operation failed. Check that the backup is valid, its format is supported and the document is accessible. Your existing diary is preserved if import fails.
A recovery backup from the most recent replacement is available. Save it before another replacement.
